resource.title: Knowledge Graphs（Springer 2021 开放获取 HTML 全书，第 4 章 Deductive Knowledge + 第 5 章 Inductive Knowledge）
resource.covers: 逐节核对目录：4.1 Ontologies（interpretations and models、ontology features、entailment、if-then vs if-and-only-if 语义）＝描述逻辑/本体的模型论基础；4.2.1 Rules（规则推理，含 Datalog 式规则与 OWL 的关系）、4.2.2 Description Logics（DL 语法与推理）；3.1.2 Validating schema 与 3.2.2 External identity links 对应语义约束与跨源语义互操作；第 5 章 Inductive Knowledge：5.2 Knowledge Graph Embeddings、5.3 Graph Neural Networks、5.4 Symbolic Learning（rule mining、axiom mining）正是神经符号结合；第 7–8 章的质量评估与 refinement 讲推理结果如何被校验与修复。

courses.school: openHPI (Hasso Plattner Institute) / FIZ Karlsruhe – KIT
courses.course: Knowledge Graphs（Harald Sack, Mehwish Alam，6 周英文 MOOC）
courses.prereq_text: Requirements for this Course: Basic understanding of web technologies, such as URL and HTTP; Basic understanding of mathematics, in particular statistics and probability theory; Basic knowledge of database technology, such as relational databases and SQL query language

courses.course: CS 520 Knowledge Graphs: Data Models, Knowledge Acquisition, Inference and Applications
courses.prereq_text: This class is a graduate level research seminar and will include lectures on knowledge graph topics (e.g., data models, creation, inference, access) and invited lectures from prominent researchers and industry practitioners.

extra_prereqs.evidence: openHPI Knowledge Graphs 要求『Basic knowledge of database technology, such as relational databases and SQL query language』
openHPI Knowledge Graphs 要求『statistics and probability theory』基础
kgbook 与 openHPI Knowledge Graphs 都先讲数据模型与本体，再讲演绎推理。

notes: D.4.1 判 not_mentioned：能查到的两门课（openHPI 的 Knowledge Graphs、Stanford CS 520）都把知识表示与推理放在同一门课里教，没有任何课程把『先学过知识表示/本体课』写成推理课的先修；CS 520 页面根本没写先修（按 unspecified 记）。资源重复风险已披露：kgbook.org 与 D.4.1 用的是同一本书（D.4.1 偏 Ch2–3、6–7 的表示与融合，本节点偏 Ch4–5 的推理与神经符号）；若主代理要求两节点资源不重复，可换成已核实的两份替代：(1) Birkbeck《Semantic Technologies》课程 slides（Michael Zakharyaschev，含 'The OWL 2 Web Ontology Language' 与 'Reasoning with description logic' 两讲，https://titan.dcs.bbk.ac.uk/~michael/sw15/sw15.html ）；(2) W3C《OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Primer (Second Edition)》（https://www.w3.org/TR/owl2-primer/ ，官方规范文档，覆盖 OWL 2 DL 语义、profile 与 entailment，但没有规则推理与神经符号内容）。
